verdict: Paid ads remain off; overdue setup work is the only thing blocking relaunch.
narrative: In the last 28 days, no spend ran on Meta or Google — both channels have been dark for 45-plus days — so there are no paid leads or cost-per-lead figures to report this period. Your Google Business Profile was the only active channel, producing 57 actions (56 direction requests, 1 website click) from 92 impressions across 23 days, though zero calls were recorded despite that visibility. GBP engagement also dropped 44% in the most recent 7 days compared to the prior 7, signaling declining reach with no paid traffic to offset it. Eight setup milestones — including conversion tracking, landing pages, and ad infrastructure — are overdue and are being resolved now as the direct prerequisite to turning paid back on. Once those are cleared, paid campaigns will relaunch and you should see leads and cost-per-lead figures return to the report.

actions from your Google Business Profile this period, driven almost entirely by direction requests
